WhatsApp Business chat and media backup
Export your Google Drive files and Google Photos with Google Takeout. The NoDrive desktop app then uploads them with the same folder structure.

1. On a computer, open Google Takeout. Choose Deselect all, then tick Drive and Google Photos.

2. Pick .zip as the file type and 50 GB as the size, so there are fewer parts. Choose to get a download link by email.

3. Download every zip file within 7 days. Each link only works a few times.

4. Unzip all of the zip files into one folder inside your NoDrive folder, for example NoDrive/Google Takeout. Folders with the same name merge. Your Drive files are then in Takeout/Drive and your photos in Takeout/Google Photos. The NoDrive desktop app uploads everything and keeps the same folder structure. Do not upload the zip files themselves.

5. Check your files on NoDrive. Delete your data at Google yourself, only when you are sure everything arrived.

Good to know: Google Docs, Sheets and Slides arrive as Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. Google Photos adds a small .json file with the date of each photo. Items that were only shared with you are not in the export.
